Name: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller
Overview:
A singing and party game featuring 40 German cult songs to sing along to – with Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller, the Xbox 360 becomes the center of every party once again.

This special edition includes 40 German Pop, Rock, Rap, and Folk hits from the last two decades. This compilation guarantees that both younger and older players get their money's worth and can sing with—and against—each other. The game supports the motion-sensitive wireless microphones from the predecessor, so players who already own Lips don't need to spend money on new hardware.

40 Cult Songs from Germany: Artists like Jan Delay (Klar), Sportfreunde Stiller (54, 74, 90, 2010), and Söhne Mannheims (Und wenn ein Lied) are represented just as much as Die Höhner (Viva Colonia), Helge Schneider (Käsebrot), and Die Zillertaler Schürzenjäger (Sierra Madre). This ensures the game covers the entire spectrum of German music and is equally interesting for players young and old.

Sing, dance, and have fun together: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is far more than "just" a karaoke game. On one hand, many songs are accompanied by their original music videos; on the other, the two motion-sensitive wireless microphones (sold separately for this version) ensure that Xbox 360 singers have to deliver a sizzling live performance to get the high score. Keiichi Yano, the Japanese developer who has already programmed several highly successful music games, was able to bring all his ideas to life with "Lips."

Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is far more than just a karaoke game and is available as a standalone version as well as in a bundle with 2 motion-sensitive wireless mics.

Your Avatar joins the game: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller allows for the integration of Xbox LIVE Avatars, which boosts the fun factor. Furthermore, this game is one of the first titles to allow players to unlock exclusive accessories for their Avatars.
